<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex38042023-09-18-114223" status="unreviewed" ana="corpusmd:colophon">sngon chad shes bya'i gnas la <lb n="52b7"/> sbyangs pa dang || 
            lhag pa'i lha'i byin gyis brlabs pa dang || 
            bshes [g]nyen dam pas rjes_su bzung ba'i mthus || 
            shes bya phal cher 'bad pa chung dus shes ||
             <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4737">bslab bya'i gnas gtan la 'bebs par byed pa'i legs <lb n="53a1"/> bshad khyad par gsum ldan</rs> zhes bya ba 'di ni | dang por <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4009">'jam pa'i dbyangs dkon mchog rin chen<anchor xml:id="a1"/> </rs>gyis <note type="gloss">bka' drin gyis</note> legs par bskyangs shing ¦ bar du <rs type="person" ana="">mkhas pa'i dbang po <abbr>gzhon nu</abbr> rgyal mchog</rs> <abbr>la sogs</abbr> pa'i gsung gi smin <lb n="53a2"/> [p]ar byas te ¦ mthar rnam dpyod kyis <abbr>blo gros</abbr> rtsa bshad kyi lung 'grel pa dang bcas <abbr>rnam par</abbr> dpyad pa la [b]rten nas ¦ 
             dgag bsgrub [sgrub] kyi [b]slab pa'i gnas la <abbr>blo gros</abbr> kyi snang ba rgyas pa ¦
             <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4009">shes rab rgya mtsho</rs>s  <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4312"><rs type="place">mnga' ris</rs> pa'i sde snod 'dzin pa <lb n="52a3"/> chen po dkon mchog bzang po<anchor xml:id="a2"/></rs> <abbr>la sogs</abbr> pas bskul ba'i ngor ¦<abbr/> <hi rendition="#Time">lcags mo <abbr>phag gi</abbr> lo</hi> ¦ <hi rendition="#Time">smal po'i zla ba'i bzang po'i tshes</hi> <anchor xml:id="a3"/>la: <rs type="place" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4411">dpal snar thang gi chos sde</rs>r rdzogs par sbyar ba'o || dge'o ||</seg></TEI>
